svg.title: Turning a PRD into tasks
svg.desc: In Claude Code, /taskgraph:parse-prd checks the PRD for open questions, then turns it into 8 tasks; task 1 is ready to start.

g.text: Turn your PRD into a plan that lasts
/help for help, /status for your current setup
The PRD had no open questions, so here are the tasks it produced:
TaskGraph: make one task wait on another. Use when a task can't start…
TaskGraph: add a subtask to a task. Use when a TaskGraph task needs a…
TaskGraph: add a task to the plan. Use when the user asks to track, fi…
TaskGraph: score how complex each task is and which to break down. Use…
TaskGraph: delete the subtasks of one task, or of every task with --al…
TaskGraph: turn a PRD or spec into tasks, asking about gaps first. Use…
TaskGraph: turn a PRD into tasks, researching the tech first. Use for…
